findings.title: Call to passkey helper does not compile
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` without arguments, but the inherited method in `UsernamePasswordForm` requires a `UserModel` argument. This prevents the services module from compiling, so the PR cannot be built or merged until the call supplies the user (or a no-argument overload is added).
